items.text: Add the date 2026-11-04: “Green Claims Commission officially confirms withdrawal of the proposal”
items.reason: The European Commission officially confirmed the withdrawal and scrapping of the Green Claims Directive proposal in November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “Officially withdrawn by the European Commission in November 2026 following the earlier suspension of trilogue negotiations.”
items.reason: The Commission officially confirmed the withdrawal of the Green Claims Directive proposal.

items.text: New status text: “In force since 10 November 2026. The revised ESRS apply from financial year 2027; the voluntary standard has been in force since 24 September 2026.”
items.reason: Updates the status text as the entry into force date of 10 November 2026 has now passed.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-12: “EU ETS provisional agreement reached on boosting free carbon allowances”
items.reason: Council and Parliament reached a provisional agreement on 12 November 2026 to boost free carbon allowances for energy-intensive industries.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-19: “SFDR 2.0 provisional agreement reached between Council and Parliament”
items.reason: The Council and European Parliament reached a provisional agreement on the SFDR 2.0 reform on 19 November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “Provisional agreement reached between the Council and European Parliament on 19 November 2026. The agreed text now awaits formal adoption.”
items.reason: Trilogue negotiations concluded with a provisional agreement on 19 November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “Applies. A provisional agreement on the SFDR revision (SFDR 2.0) was reached by the Council and Parliament on 19 November 2026.”
items.reason: Trilogue negotiations on the SFDR review have concluded with a provisional deal.

items.text: Change the stage from Adopted to In force
items.reason: The revised ESRS entered into force on 10 November 2026.
